fusions.name: Barb Left In
fusions.desc: A stinging weapon strike that costs 4% of your maximum health. It deals 9 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, and the barb left in it slows it by 25% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Stuck in the Comb
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stingers in a spread out to 6 tiles. Each stinger deals 3 damage, and its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Honey Pot
fusions.desc: Sets out honey that draws up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. A swarm fights beside you for 9 seconds, stinging for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Kicked Hive
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, a sting flies to the nearest enemy within 4 tiles and deals 5 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
